Itch.io Page:
ZODIAC DIVINE JUSTICE
Come check out my new JRPG game called Zodiac Divine Justice! My first completed project and a test run for my main project that I have going which is going to bigger, better and different yet similar to this game. As mentioned below, I entered this for a game jam but I had some personal goals too, I wanted the retro feel, similar to the NES and Retro JRPGs such as Dragon Quest. On top of this, I also wanted to restrict file size, and in doing so I have managed to get the game to be less than 700KB! All made within RPG Maker 2000.
This is Game I made for a 2 week game jam that just finished and because of that I won't be able to update/patch for roughly another weeks, I already have a patch in mind as I have found a few mistakes with the dialogue already, but feel free to report any bugs you find the comments so I can get to work on fixing them for the post review period patch!
You can play it in the browser or download either the EasyRPG version or the 720KB Floppy Disk img for Windows 98(you can use PCem and setup a virtual Windows 98 environment to try it or get a real floppy disk and burn the contents to it and try it on real retro hardware!).
